title: Taiwan president cancels trip to Eswatini, accuses China of pressuring African countries
description: TAIPEI, Apr 21 : Taiwan’s president cancelled a planned visit to Africa this week after three countries withdrew permission for him to fly over their territories, under pressure from China, his office said Tuesday. “According to our understanding, the cancellation of flight permits by Seychelles, Mauritius, and Madagascar without prior warning was actually due to strong pressure from the Chinese authorities, including economic coercion,” read a statement by the presidential office.
